description: Source code for a GitLab API client class that fetches files, lists directories, and manages repository interactions.

classes.name: GitLabClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the GitLab API to fetch files, list directories, and manage repository info.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the GitLabClient with configuration parameters, setting up authentication and API URL.

methods.name: _file_raw_url
methods.description: Constructs URL for fetching raw file content from GitLab.

methods.name: _file_json_url
methods.description: Constructs URL for fetching file content in JSON format from GitLab.

methods.name: _tree_url
methods.description: Constructs URL for listing directory contents in the repository.

methods.name: set_ref
methods.description: Overrides the default reference (branch or tag) for subsequent API calls.

methods.name: get_file_content
methods.description: Fetches file content from GitLab, trying raw endpoint first, then JSON fallback.

methods.name: _get_file_content_via_json
methods.description: Fallback method to fetch file content via JSON API when raw endpoint fails.

methods.name: list_files
methods.description: Lists files in a directory with a specific extension, optionally recursively.

methods.name: get_repository_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about the GitLab repository.

methods.name: test_connection
methods.description: Tests connectivity to the GitLab project.

methods.name: get_branches
methods.description: Retrieves list of branches in the repository.

methods.name: get_file_metadata
methods.description: Fetches minimal metadata about a file via headers.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the HTTP handler to free resources.
